home.about: Engineer and MSc Student in Cybersecurity at Politecnico di Torino and EURECOM with a keen interest in information security and cybersecurity. Experienced in software development, networking, system security, and machine learning. Solution-focused and proactive, I work best under pressure and enjoy learning new things.

items.title: Project Management Fundamentals
items.description: Successfully completed 42 hours of intensive training in project management fundamentals at EURECOM, achieving a final grade above 80%.

items.title: Side-Channel Power Attack on ASCON-AEAD128
items.description: ASCON-AEAD128 firmware on an ARM Cortex-M4 microcontroller, attacked with Correlation Power Analysis that recovers the full 128-bit key in 21,500 power traces, with a Boolean-masked countermeasure validated via TVLA.

items.title: AI/ML for UE Positioning in 5G O-RAN
items.description: Variational Autoencoder-based NLoS anomaly detection for UWB localization, reaching 97% detection accuracy, integrated as an xApp within the FlexRIC framework.

items.title: NXP S32K3X8EVB QEMU Emulation
items.description: Extended QEMU's ARM Cortex-M7 support to emulate the S32K3X8EVB board, with UART/GPIO mapping, a FreeRTOS runtime, and a Memory Protection Unit prototype.

items.title: YouTube CDN Traffic Analysis
items.description: Analyzed YouTube's CDN behavior on real network data using regression and clustering to estimate flow throughput and detect topology changes.

items.title: NTIRE 2026 — Robust AI-Generated Image Detection
items.description: TransFusionNet: CLIP + DINOv2 token fusion with a spatial transformer to tell real images from AI-generated ones, robust to JPEG compression, blur, and resize.
